title: The Little Moon Who Wanted to Shine
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A little moon whose light is soft and gentle discovers that you are special just as you are, and your gentle light matters to the world.
long_description: Luna is a little moon whose light is soft and gentle. She longs to shine bright like all the stars. When she helps a child sleep peacefully, Luna discovers a wonderful secret: you are special just as you are, and your gentle light matters to the world. A gentle bedtime story about self-acceptance, kindness, and shining in your own way.
moral_lesson: You are special just as you are — your gentle light matters to the world.
